newsitem.title: USA: Cambodian trade bill goes to Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian trade bill goes to Clinton.

text.p: A bill extending permanent Most Favoured Trade status to Cambodia cleared Congress on Thursday and went to President Bill Clinton for signature.

The House voted to approve the measure after accepting Senate language noting that Cambodia had made progress toward democracy and expansion of its economy and that extension of Most Favoured Nation status would assist in further democratic progress and adherance to world trade principles.
Under Most Favoured Nation staus, Cambodia's exports to the United States would receive the same tariff treatement given to the exports of most of America's trading partners.
